summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV filed Form 6-K disclosing a weekly update on its pre-announced share repurchase program. Between July 6-10, 2026, the company repurchased 108,645 ordinary shares at an average price of €26.67 per share on Euronext Amsterdam and other trading venues, for a total consideration of ~€2.9 million. The program was originally announced on June 9, 2026. As of July 10, 2026, Lakefront holds 412,401 treasury shares. There is no board recommendation, advisor, or premium disclosed as this is an open-market buyback. The filing is a routine reporting of issuer tender activity under a previously authorized program. What to watch: continuation of repurchase pace as part of the company's capital return strategy; no risk-arb angle as this is not a tender offer.
